subtitle: Earn your crew. Build your line.
description: Twelve winding courses, three campaign chapters and six cars. Earn reputation to unlock cars and parts, then allocate a six-point build. Race, escape, drift and intercept through staged objectives and closing battles. Earn real Relay Credits with itemized first-clear, chapter and sector rewards.
heroDescription: Earn your crew license across three chapters. Reconfigure permanent purchased parts within a six-point budget, then carry your relay through twelve circuits. Finish with a clean drift exit or secure the final interception target and a podium. Solo racing with verified career carry.
replayDescription: V13 binds campaign licenses, purchased parts, active builds, staged objectives and career rewards to its exact native application profile. V8–V12 races and exports keep their original executors. Historical PBs are separate from current-rule records. Myelin provides off-chain host replay, not CKB settlement.
